title: Expand Phase 2 pool admission

acceptance_criteria.1_config_keys: All 6 new keys (PHASE2_CV_MIN_WORST_RETURN=-8.0, PHASE2_CV_MIN_WORST_PF=0.80, PHASE2_CV_MAX_WORST_DD=18.0, PHASE2_CV_MIN_FOLD_TRADES=10, PHASE2_KEEP_TOP_RULES=140, PHASE2_STRICT_POSITIVE_GOOD=True) present and accessible.
acceptance_criteria.2_pool_admission_impl: _passes_pool_admission_impl uses new relaxed CV_* thresholds for cv_fold=True (val_ret_min=-8.0, pf_floor=0.80, min_val_trades=10, max_drawdown gate=18%). Non-CV path unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.3_pool_cap: _build_pool_from_archive caps pool at PHASE2_KEEP_TOP_RULES=140, sorted by deployability_rank_score descending.
acceptance_criteria.4_unit_tests: New test file tests/unit/test_phase2_pool_admission.py with 10 tests covering relaxed thresholds, positive-good gate, holdout unchanged, config presence.
acceptance_criteria.5_existing_tests: All 201+ existing related tests pass (phase2_support, phase2_cv_admission, phase2_cv, phase2_rule_pool, positive_good_gate, config_additions, evox_runner, etc.).
acceptance_criteria.6_no_changes: No changes to evaluator_v5.ipynb, GPU engine, or JSON output contract.

notes_for_reviewer: PHASE2_STRICT_POSITIVE_GOOD flipped to True as required; existing tests that use basic admission gate with sub-Phase3 trade counts were patched to set PHASE2_STRICT_POSITIVE_GOOD=False (test_phase2_support.py, test_phase2_cv_admission.py).
The per-fold drawdown gate (PHASE2_CV_MAX_WORST_DD=18.0) is applied to both train and val metrics within the cv_fold=True path.
The pool capping in _build_pool_from_archive uses a local import of deployability_rank_score to avoid circular imports.
Integration test (acceptance criterion #5) is OPTIONAL per task spec; not run due to RAM constraints.
All 6 new config keys use the friend's getattr(..., default) pattern with fallback defaults matching the expected values.
